_readme: S721 (lever), the gap census's reader_page_assignment lever (run 45371224551): 2 programs of College of the Redwoods whose filed record places none of the state's listed courses because the 2026-27 catalog prints the program under another award. Free page read 45381629186 read each program's page and the catalog's menu; the college's other 3 programs on the lever are pinned in its reconcile entry (kb/program_requirements_reconcile.json, site_pages). These are filed as named gaps and are never sent to a paid read. Their filed records stay as filed (the load skips a record that places none). No model call, no Supabase write. They are the college's to settle in COCI.

reasons.catalog_award_differs: The state lists the program as a Certificate of Achievement, and the 2026-27 catalog prints its page, the only one under its title, as an A.S. Degree: the extraction, asked for the certificate, finds no certificate section and records no list.

programs.title: Early Childhood Education
programs.award: Certificate of Achievement: 18  or greater semester(or 27  or greater quarter) units
programs.note: early-childhood-education-fall-2018 prints 'Early Childhood Education' over 'A.S. Degree ( 27.0 Credits )', a Required Core of 24 units (ECE 1, 2, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10, 18) and 3 units of restricted electives; the menu lists no other Early Childhood page beside the A.S.-T's (31662). The filed record's notes say it found the A.S. section and no certificate section.
